subject: Subscription hygiene — exposure log & action plan for OliveTech
messages:
From: Sara Oliver <sara.oliver@olivetech.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: OliveTech Finance <finance@olivetech.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subscription hygiene — exposure log request

Hi Alex,

Quick ask before our Q3 forecasting window closes: can you send over an exposure log for OliveTech that lists upcoming renewals (90 days), any accounts with usage > 3x baseline in the last 60 days, and a short note on where we see churn risk (reason + recommended mitigation)? Finance is asking for that sheet to reconcile ARR movement this week.

Also, Sara M from procurement will likely push on committed seats vs. actual usage — would be helpful to include a recommended staging for each subscription (e.g., Commit / At Risk / Renewal Pending).

Can you get a draft to me by EOD tomorrow? If it's easier, we can do a 30m call to walk through.

Thanks,
Sara Oliver
VP Customer Success
OliveTech Inc.

Attachments: OliveTech_Q3_internal_notes.pdf (pdf)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Oliver <sara.oliver@olivetech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription hygiene — exposure log request

Hi Sara — thanks for the note. We're on it. I've attached a preliminary exposure log (redwood_exposure_olivetech_q3.xlsx) that pulls renewals through 90 days, flagged accounts with usage spikes, and a suggested stage for each subscription. The sheet includes a short rationale column for churn drivers.

Proposed next steps:
- Please review the attached draft and highlight any corrections to renewal dates or contract terms.
- I can run a 30m review Wed or Thu morning PST — proposed times: Wed 9:30-10:00 or Thu 10:00-10:30.
- If Finance wants to include a scenario for a 10% credit or extended payment terms, Naomi is cc'd to provide ARR impact and recommended accounting treatment.

I've also started a mutual action plan (MAP_OliveTech_v1.docx) with milestones for the renewal. Will iterate after your review.

Attachment: redwood_exposure_olivetech_q3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription hygiene — exposure log request

Alex — quick internal note after skimming the draft:
- The 3 largest subscriptions (Accounts A, B, C) have renewal dates that look correct, but usage trend for Account B is volatile — recommend staging as "At Risk (50%)" rather than Commit.
- For any account with >3x spike, add a one-line recommended mitigation: "usage audit + price refresh" or "limit burst/guardrails".
- Can you confirm whether the MAP includes a clause for short-term burst credits? That will affect the finance ask.

If you want me to join the review call Wed, I can — otherwise I can provide the staging updates directly in the sheet.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Renewal Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Oliver <sara.oliver@olivetech.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription hygiene — exposure log request

Thanks — adding the Finance perspective. I ran a quick ARR sensitivity on the attached forecast_adjustment_sheet.csv. Key points:
- If we mark Account B as At Risk and model a 20% contraction, uncovered ARR impact is ~$48k over 12 months.
- If we offer a one-time 15% credit to smooth renewal friction, net ARR impact is smaller (~$18k) but will require approval from sales leadership for a policy exception.
- For forecasting purposes this week, I recommend we tag Account B as "At Risk - 50%" and move Account C to "Commit - 90%" (usage stable).

I've added a HubSpot note to DEAL-4931 with the assumptions used: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4931. Once you finalize the MAP, I'll capture the approved treatment in the forecast and flag in the weekly finops report.

Attachment: forecast_adjustment_sheet.csv (spreadsheet)

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Oliver <sara.oliver@olivetech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription hygiene — exposure log request

Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround on questions. Per our internal sync, final action items below and attached is the updated MAP (MAP_OliveTech_v1.docx) with agreed staging:

Action items / owners:
- Alex: schedule 30m review call (Thu 9/9 16:00 PT) and walk through exposure sheet; confirm any contract date corrections.
- Lauren: update staging in the exposure sheet to reflect "Account B — At Risk (50%)", update mitigation text.
- Naomi: record forecast adjustment for Account B as At Risk in DEAL-4931 and model the 20% contraction scenario for the weekly finops sync.
- Sara / OliveTech: confirm whether procurement will accept a one-time 15% credit or prefers a 30-day payment extension.

I've attached the updated MAP and final exposure sheet for your review. If procurement confirms credit, Naomi will update ARR impact and I'll request a policy exception.

Attachments: MAP_OliveTech_v1.docx (document), redwood_exposure_olivetech_q3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks all — talk in a couple hours.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
